scope: Source/ownership/preservation/closure and observed host drift only. This collector neither executes nor certifies acceptance gates, production deployment or whole-phase completion.

parserTool.source: Existing frontend lock-bound parser used only by the local capture tool; no runtime dependency was added.

limits: Static exact local imports, literal Rust embedded sources and explicitly registered fixtures are checked here. Dynamic paths, installed packages and bundler resolution are additionally verified by locked installation, the real build and tests.

observedStart.note: Observed before any Phase 19 product edits. Initial delegation was read-only. This working-tree baseline preserves earlier uncommitted phases and post-Phase18 documentation changes.

sharedRegistrationMeaning: Only phase19 required cfg(test) and CI markers are checked here. Shared host bytes may differ from the exercised candidate; registration markers are not execution or policy-test evidence.

provenanceSelection.limitation: Union-of-selected-path deltas are not an exhaustive filesystem or external-work audit. Selection changes do not establish physical creation/deletion. Unselected work is not certified.

legacyMeaning: The declared legacy Node backend compatibility set is checked separately. The platform-e2e Node fixture may add necessary memberLookups configuration; old Rust write/live and platform policy fixtures deliberately evolve for phase19. The registered CI runner mock count correction derives its expected count from the manifest and is a declared owned fixture change. No blanket assertion that all historical tests or the entire former legacy boundary remain unchanged is made.

dependencies.limitation: Byte-identical business Cargo inputs inherit prior package identities and recorded metadata. No fresh vulnerability, license or legal audit is claimed.

auxiliaryDocumentationAndTemplate.meaning: Auxiliary hashes do not prove executable behavior or certify changed current document bytes as tested.

testOnlyBoundary.limitation: The cfg(test) harness, integration-test location and absence of these named fixture markers in production route sources are checked. This is a bounded source check, not an exhaustive arbitrary-route or production-build audit.

externalWorkBoundary: Phase23 notification, Phase25 admin and other concurrent work are preserved without adoption as phase19 implementation. Required policy/fixture edits listed by the shared definition are attributed narrowly. Shared CI/current documentation drift remains separately recorded.
